notes: Entry date is the TechCrunch article date (2024-07-10, 'has already raised'); the close date is not given. Index's partner says 'We backed them at pre-seed and seed' (BusinessCloud 2026-05-12) and Pulse 2.0 says total funding is 'over $30 million', so there was likely a further unannounced seed-stage raise between the $4.9M and the Series A; the $4.9M TechCrunch calls 'seed funds' may include the pre-seed. Visionaries co-led the $4.9M, so it is in at the earliest named round. Founded: Adfin Financial Services Ltd, Companies House 15449959, incorporated 2024-01-29, 66 Paul Street, London. Series A: $18M (GBP 13M), Index lead, existing investor Visionaries Club, plus Stéphane Kurgan and Andrey Khusid; no valuation disclosed.
